Subfigures

Top left

temp1a_state = state_wis |>
    group_by(model_id, target) |>
    summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis), count = n(), .groups = "drop")
temp1a_state$type = "state-scoring"

temp1a_standard = standard_wis |>
    group_by(model_id, target) |>
    summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis), count = n(), .groups = "drop")
temp1a_standard$type = "standard-scoring"

temp1a = rbind(temp1a_standard, temp1a_state)
temp1a = temp1a |>
    filter(target == "Flu ED visits pct")
figure1a = ggplot(temp1a, aes(x = fct_reorder(model_id, mean_wis,
    .fun = max), y = mean_wis, fill = type)) + geom_col(position = "dodge",
    color = "black") + scale_fill_manual(values = c(`standard-scoring` = "firebrick",
    `state-scoring` = "royalblue")) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,
    2.5), breaks = c(0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3), expand = expansion(mult = 0,
    add = 0.03)) + labs(x = "Model", y = "Mean WIS", fill = "Scoring Method") +
    theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "top") + coord_flip()

figure1a

Top right

temp1b_state = state_wis |>
    group_by(model_id, location, target) |>
    summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis), count = n(), .groups = "drop")

temp1b_standard = standard_wis |>
    group_by(model_id, location, target) |>
    summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis), count = n(), .groups = "drop")

temp1b = rbind(temp1b_standard, temp1b_state)
temp1b = temp1b |>
    filter(target == "Flu ED visits pct")
figure1b = ggplot(temp1b, aes(x = fct_reorder(location, mean_wis,
    .fun = sum), y = mean_wis, fill = model_id)) + geom_col() +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0, add = 0.03)) +
    labs(x = "Location", y = "Mean WIS", fill = "Model") + theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top") + coord_flip()
